title: State of AI in 2026: LLMs, Coding, Scaling Laws, China, Agents, GPUs, AGI
description: Comprehensive discussion covering the current state of AI in 2026, including topics like LLMs, coding, scaling laws, China, AI agents, GPUs, and AGI. This video provides insights into the latest developments and future directions of AI technology.
author: Lex Fridman Podcast

title: The Agents We Actually Built, and What Replit's Founder Thinks Comes Next
description: Amjad Masad speaks at Saastr AI 2026 about AI agents, revealing that he 'doesn't code anymore' and calling it a 'small crisis'. He joked about 'holding a funeral for coding at the Computer History Museum' and advised developers to 'learn fast'. Discussion covers vibe coding and the future of software development.
author: Amjad Masad

title: Smoke Signals from the Future: The Death of Coding and What Comes Next
description: Replit CEO Amjad Masad delivers a 'wake-up call' to 'learn to think, not code'. Discusses 'vibe-coding' where users build apps together 'like they're doodling', describing a fundamental shift in how software will be created.
author: Pavilion Blog (featuring Amjad Masad)

title: Kimi K3, and what we can still learn from the pelican benchmark
description: Chinese AI lab Moonshot AI announced Kimi K3 with 2.8 trillion parameters, calling it the first 'open 3T-class model'. Simon analyzes the model using his pelican benchmark, discussing pricing ($3/million input, $15/million output), performance comparison with Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6, and insights about model evaluation.
author: Simon Willison

title: My LLM coding workflow going into 2026
description: Addy Osmani shares his LLM coding workflow for 2026, including starting with clear plans (specs before code), breaking work into small iterations, and leveraging AI coding tools effectively.
author: Addy Osmani

title: Andrej Karpathy: From Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering
description: YouTube discussion about what's changed in the year since Karpathy coined 'vibe coding' and why agentic engineering is the more serious discipline taking shape. Karpathy explains that vibe coding raises the floor (lets almost anyone create software) while agentic engineering raises the ceiling.
author: Andrej Karpathy
